set.body:
Acknowledged. I will treat this as a product requirement, not just a documentation complaint: the checked core may be rigorous, but ordinary workflows need a small progressive API where the first screen reads like input -> analyze -> inspect or align, and receipts/policies appear when the user asks for advanced or remote behavior. For C1 I will keep the public vocabulary minimal and domain-named, preserve smart-constructor truthfulness, and refuse internal orchestration types leaking into the common path. After the algorithmic core is verified, the right separate slice is an ergonomic facade plus executable WOG journey, with an explicit court that the facade cannot bypass provenance, privacy, or validation. No API/source expansion is implied before chief scope.

set.title: API ergonomics: progressive facade after the algorithmic core is verified
